prompt: Our flat is very small. If we (to have) a bigger kitchen, we (to invite) friends for dinner more often.
explanation_ru: Кухня маленькая, значит ситуация нереальна сейчас: в if-части Past Simple (had), в главной would + глагол.

prompt: Your laptop is always so slow. If I ___ you, I would buy a new one.
explanation_ru: В совете If I were you после I всегда ставится were; am и will be после if не подходят.

prompt: If I would live closer to the sea, I would swim every morning.
answer: If I lived closer to the sea, I would swim every morning.
accepted_answers: If I lived closer to the sea, I would swim every morning.
If I lived closer to the sea, I'd swim every morning.
explanation_ru: После if нельзя ставить would («если бы» ≠ if + would): в условной части нужен Past Simple, lived.

prompt: I don't have permission to change the timetable, so I can't help you. → If I …
answer: If I had permission to change the timetable, I could help you.
accepted_answers: If I had permission to change the timetable, I could help you.
If I had permission to change the timetable, I would help you.
If I had permission to change the timetable, I'd help you.
explanation_ru: Факт сейчас не верен, поэтому в if-части Past Simple (had), а в главной could или would + глагол.

prompt: If the app didn't crash every time I opened the camera, I would use it much more.
options: The app crashed once, so I stopped using the camera.
The app never crashes, but I still use it a lot.
The app crashes whenever I open the camera, so I don't use it much.
The app doesn't crash now, so I use it more than before.
explanation_ru: Второй тип про настоящее: didn't crash значит «на самом деле вылетает», would use more значит «пользуюсь мало».

prompt: A: Why don't you join the school choir? B: I'm not a good singer. If I (to be) better, I (to join) at once. A: But you sing in the shower every morning! B: That's different. If I (to stand) on a stage, I (not / to remember) a single word.
explanation_ru: Все четыре пропуска про воображаемое: в if-части Past Simple (were/was, stood), в главной would + глагол.

prompt: We missed the last train. If we (to leave) the café ten minutes earlier, we (to catch) it.
explanation_ru: Поезд уже ушёл, прошлое не изменить: if + Past Perfect (had left), в главной would have + V3 (caught).

prompt: The hotel gave us a free shuttle to the airport. If it hadn't, we ___ a taxi.
explanation_ru: Условие в Past Perfect (hadn't) относится к прошлому, значит результат: would have + V3 (would have taken).

prompt: A lost bag on a bus.
sentences: Rustam left his bag on the bus last Friday.
If he would have checked his seat before getting off, he would have noticed it.
Luckily, the driver took the bag to the station.
Rustam would have lost his passport if the driver didn't hand it in.
Now he says he will never travel without a checklist again.

fixes.1: If he had checked his seat before getting off, he would have noticed it.
fixes.3: Rustam would have lost his passport if the driver hadn't handed it in.

explanation_ru: В предложении 1 после if стоит would have вместо had + V3; в предложении 3 в if-части для прошлого нужен hadn't handed, а не didn't hand.

prompt: Our goalkeeper was ill, so we lost the match. → If our goalkeeper …
answer: If our goalkeeper hadn't been ill, we wouldn't have lost the match.
accepted_answers: If our goalkeeper hadn't been ill, we wouldn't have lost the match.
If our goalkeeper had not been ill, we wouldn't have lost the match.
If our goalkeeper hadn't been ill, we would not have lost the match.
If our goalkeeper had not been ill, we would not have lost the match.
explanation_ru: Реальность была: вратарь заболел и мы проиграли; в нереальном прошлом знаки меняются: hadn't been ill, wouldn't have lost.

prompt: If Dad hadn't stopped to answer the phone in the hall, the cake wouldn't have burnt.
options: Dad answered the phone and the cake didn't burn.
Dad didn't answer the phone, so the cake burnt.
Dad stopped to answer the phone and the cake burnt.
Dad didn't answer the phone, and the cake didn't burn.
explanation_ru: Оба отрицания в третьем типе меняют факт: отец остановился ответить, и пирог сгорел.

prompt: Match the halves.
pairs: If the lift had been working,
we wouldn't have climbed ten floors.
If the plumber hadn't arrived so fast,
If I had remembered the code,
I could have opened the door myself.
If the landlord had answered our emails,
we wouldn't have needed to call him.
explanation_ru: Во всех парах условие нереально в прошлом (had + V3), результат would/could have + V3; пары подбираются по смыслу.

prompt: My uncle Idowu grew up near the sea, so he is a strong swimmer. If he (to grow) up in the desert, he (not / to be) such a good swimmer.
explanation_ru: Условие про прошлое (где вырос), результат про сегодняшний день: had grown + would not be.

prompt: I never learned to drive, so I depend on buses. If I ___ to drive when I was younger, I wouldn't spend two hours commuting every day.
explanation_ru: Условие относится к прошлому (when I was younger), результат к настоящему: if + Past Perfect, would + глагол.

prompt: My sister is afraid of flying, so she didn't come with us to Spain last summer. Which sentence fits?
options: If she weren't afraid of flying, she would have come with us.
If she hadn't been afraid of flying, she would come with us now.
If she isn't afraid of flying, she will come with us.
If she weren't afraid of flying, she would come with us last summer.
explanation_ru: Условие про постоянное свойство сейчас (weren't afraid), результат про прошлое (would have come); остальные варианты путают время.

prompt: If I had booked a room in advance, I wouldn't be sleeping on this sofa tonight.
options: I booked a room, but I'm sleeping on this sofa tonight.
I didn't book a room, so I slept on the sofa last night.
I booked a room, so I'm not sleeping on the sofa tonight.
I didn't book a room, so I'm sleeping on this sofa tonight.
explanation_ru: Past Perfect показывает, что комнату не забронировали, а wouldn't be sleeping про сегодняшний вечер: сегодня спит на диване.

prompt: Our village football team is bottom of the league. Last summer our best player moved abroad. If he (to stay), we (to be) much higher in the table now. Our new goalkeeper is only sixteen. If he (to be) older, he (not / to let) in three easy goals on Sunday.
explanation_ru: В первой паре условие в прошлом, результат сейчас (had stayed + would be); во второй условие про нынешний возраст, результат в прошлом (were + would not have let).

prompt: The neighbour's dog barked all night, so I'm exhausted today. → If the neighbour's dog …
answer: If the neighbour's dog hadn't barked all night, I wouldn't be exhausted today.
accepted_answers: If the neighbour's dog hadn't barked all night, I wouldn't be exhausted today.
If the neighbour's dog had not barked all night, I wouldn't be exhausted today.
If the neighbour's dog hadn't barked all night, I would not be exhausted today.
If the neighbour's dog had not barked all night, I would not be exhausted today.
explanation_ru: Причина в прошлом (лай ночью), следствие сейчас: hadn't barked + wouldn't be.

prompt: Hurry up, or we (to miss) the last bus home.
explanation_ru: Повелительное наклонение + or: скрытое условие «если не поторопимся», реальное будущее, поэтому will miss.

prompt: I really enjoyed living in that flat. ___ the very high rent, I would never have moved out.
explanation_ru: But for + существительное значит «если бы не»; But и Unless не дают такого смысла, а Because нарушает логику.

prompt: Without we had a map of the old town, we would have got lost in the first hour.
answer: Without a map of the old town, we would have got lost in the first hour.
accepted_answers: Without a map of the old town, we would have got lost in the first hour.
Without a map of the old town, we would have gotten lost in the first hour.
Without a map of the old town, we'd have got lost in the first hour.
Without a map of the old town, we'd have gotten lost in the first hour.
If we hadn't had a map of the old town, we would have got lost in the first hour.
explanation_ru: После without идёт существительное, а не целое предложение со сказуемым.

prompt: Build the sentence.
answer: Reply by noon, or the offer will disappear.
accepted_answers: Reply by noon, or the offer will disappear.
explanation_ru: Приказ + or + результат: скрытое условие «если не ответите».

prompt: A: Are you free after work? B: I might be. If so, I (to call) you from the bus stop. A: And if you can't make it? B: In that case, I (to text) you before six. A: Fine, see you.
explanation_ru: If so и in that case подразумевают условие по ситуации; будущее реально, поэтому will + глагол.

prompt: It's freezing in here. I wish I (to have) a warmer jacket.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о настоящем: после wish ставится Past Simple (had).

prompt: It has been raining since breakfast, and I want to go for a run. I wish it ___ .
explanation_ru: Раздражение или желание перемен: I wish + would + глагол; stops, will stop и has stopped после wish не используются.

prompt: I wish I had accepted the job in Edinburgh instead of staying in my old office.
options: I accepted the job in Edinburgh, but I regret it.
I didn't accept the job in Edinburgh, and now I regret it.
I didn't accept the job in Edinburgh, and I hope to accept it.
I accepted the job in Edinburgh, and I am happy.
explanation_ru: Wish + Past Perfect значит сожаление о прошлом: работу не приняли, и теперь жалеют.

prompt: I'm sorry I didn't revise more for the exam. → I wish …
answer: I wish I had revised more for the exam.
accepted_answers: I wish I had revised more for the exam.
I wish I'd revised more for the exam.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о прошлом выражается через wish + Past Perfect.

prompt: If only my brother were here; he would know how to fix this tap.
answer: If only my brother were here; he would know how to fix this tap.
accepted_answers: If only my brother were here; he would know how to fix this tap.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: If only + were про настоящее, would know в главной части.

prompt: You can park here ___ you leave before eight. Take a sandwich ___ you get hungry on the train. I won't sign the contract ___ I read every page first. I'm going to the match ___ it rains; nothing will stop me.
explanation_ru: As long as ставит условие, in case означает «на всякий случай», unless значит «если не», even if значит «даже если».

prompt: Of course you can borrow my car for the weekend, ___ you promise to fill the tank before you bring it back.
explanation_ru: Provided (that) задаёт условие «при условии, что»; unless значило бы обратное, in case не условие, whether не подходит по смыслу.

prompt: We will go camping only if the weather is dry. → We won't go camping unless …
answer: We won't go camping unless the weather is dry.
accepted_answers: We won't go camping unless the weather is dry.
We will not go camping unless the weather is dry.
explanation_ru: Unless = if not: главная часть отрицательная, а после unless глагол в утвердительной форме.

prompt: Take your card with you in case you will need to pay for the tickets.
answer: Take your card with you in case you need to pay for the tickets.
accepted_answers: Take your card with you in case you need to pay for the tickets.
explanation_ru: После in case будущее не ставится: нужно Present Simple (you need).
